regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-directional rotation with Oil & Gas Producers as the eligible leader (durability 0.68, crowded) and Gold Miners as the challenger. Eight of sixteen themes are eligible via the absolute-trend gate, which backtests as genuine drawdown control (gate_helps true) — but the momentum rank itself has no forward return edge (rank-IC ~0), so this is a vol-aware focus lens, not a buy list. Track record of 99 calls shows 64.6% directional hits but only 34.3% direction accuracy ratio, so calibrate conviction low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Oil & Gas Producers loses its eligible status (trend-gate flips to ineligible) while Gold Miners holds eligible — a confirmed handoff in trend staying-power, not just rank. The watch retires if XEG.TO re-establishes a higher high above its 50-day average while XGD.TO stays flat or lower through the next 15 sessions.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Leader on momentum rank with highest durability_bar (0.68) and strong breadth (0.786), and it passes the absolute-trend gate — the only validated leg here is drawdown avoidance, so an overweight is defensible as staying with the prevailing trend rather than forecasting returns. Crowding_z of 1.04 (crowded) is a sizing caution, not a fade trigger.
theses.dissent: Crowded leadership with hurst_tag 'mixed' (not clean trend) — crowding marks tops in thematic ETFs and the momentum rank has no alpha; the leader may be late-stage rather than durable.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its own 50-day average and stays there over 10 sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Challenger with rank 2 and eligible via the trend gate; durability_bar 0.48 is lower than the leader but positive, and breadth 0.267 is thin. Not crowded (crowding_z 0.2). This is a secondary trend-following lean supported mainly by gate eligibility and rank, not a call that gold leads the rotation.
theses.dissent: Thin breadth and lower durability mean gold could be a short-lived pop rather than a sustained trend; the macro backdrop shows 'markets' and 'geopolitics' dominating headlines with high unscheduled share, which can reverse commodity themes abruptly.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO falls below its own 50-day average while XEG.TO stays above its own average for 10 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
